commands.name: StartTaskExecution
input: execution_revision: int>=0 where 0 means exact absence of task_execution_projection and task_execution_events
effective_start_utc: known UTC whole second integer >=0 or exact ASCII string canonical-now
steps: pure-preflight require canonical task_id UUIDv4 text, positive integer task_revision, nonnegative integer execution_revision and effective_start_utc either an integer UTC whole second >=0 or the exact case-sensitive ASCII string canonical-now

inside one writer UoW load the exact Task and execution authority; missing Task returns TASK_NOT_FOUND, task revision mismatch returns TASK_STALE, execution_revision=0 is current only when both task_execution_projection and task_execution_events are absent, and when a projection exists its positive revision must exactly equal execution_revision; projection/history inconsistency fails closed rather than fabricating state

fold current-effective execution evidence and require execution_state=not_started with no current terminal reviewed outcome; a current-effective start returns TASK_EXECUTION_ALREADY_STARTED and terminal execution/outcome returns TASK_EXECUTION_ALREADY_TERMINAL before receipt/domain mutation

after all freshness/eligibility checks, resolve canonical-now exactly once to the server canonical UTC whole second for this first execution; the request hash continues to bind the literal canonical-now token rather than the resolved instant
insert one receipt then append exactly one start execution event at the accepted effective instant

create task_execution_projection at revision 1 when prior execution authority was exactly absent, otherwise rebuild it from complete execution history and advance its revision exactly once; increment tasks.revision exactly once
rebuild any affected Objective aggregate projection in the same UoW from current member execution/outcome authority; do not change Objective identity/envelope or any Task plan/source fact
audit one task.execution_changed.v1 event with the start execution-event ref plus resulting Task/execution revisions and commit atomically
rules: Task may start independently; no other member Task starts implicitly
plan is not actual execution

execution_revision=0 is an exact absence freshness token, not a persisted projection revision and not a synonym for every logical not_started state; corrected history may yield not_started with a positive execution revision
canonical-now is a semantic request token, not a transport omission/default: exact command replay returns the immutable original result and never re-resolves current time

every material accepted execution mutation advances the umbrella tasks.revision as well as its independent execution projection revision so cross-domain Task-revision captures cannot cross unseen lifecycle changes

commands.name: StartSelectedObjectiveTasks
input: objective_id: canonical UUIDv4 grouping scope only
selected_tasks: nonempty unique array length 1..100 of {task_id: canonical UUIDv4, task_revision: int>=1, execution_revision: int>=0 where 0 means exact execution authority absence}
effective_start_utc: known UTC whole second integer >=0 or exact ASCII string canonical-now
steps: pure-preflight require canonical objective/task UUIDs, positive Objective/Task revisions, nonnegative execution revisions, selected_tasks length 1..100 with duplicate task_id rejected, and canonical-sort selected_tasks by task_id for COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 hashing; effective_start_utc is either an integer UTC whole second >=0 or the exact case-sensitive ASCII string canonical-now

COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 target is the Objective; request hash binds objective_revision, objective_envelope_revision, the canonical task_id-sorted selected_tasks tuples and the literal effective_start_utc request token/value

inside one writer UoW load the exact current nonsuperseded Objective and envelope; missing Objective returns OBJECTIVE_NOT_FOUND and objective/envelope revision mismatch returns OBJECTIVE_STALE before receipt/domain mutation

revalidate every selected Task is a current member of that exact Objective and load its exact Task/execution authority; Task revision mismatch or execution revision/absence mismatch returns TASK_STALE, projection/history inconsistency fails closed, current-effective start returns TASK_EXECUTION_ALREADY_STARTED and terminal execution/outcome returns TASK_EXECUTION_ALREADY_TERMINAL

after the full selected set is proven current/executable, resolve canonical-now once to one shared server canonical UTC whole second for all selected start events; the request hash binds the literal token
insert one outer receipt only after the entire selected set is current and executable

append exactly one start event per explicitly selected Task in canonical task_id order; for each selected Task create execution projection revision 1 when prior authority was exactly absent or otherwise advance the existing positive execution projection revision exactly once, and increment that Task's tasks.revision exactly once

rebuild the Objective aggregate exactly once from complete current membership after all selected Task writes; do not create an Objective start event/timestamp, change Objective identity/envelope revision, or touch unselected Task execution

audit one task.execution_batch_started.v1 event at Objective scope with selected_task_ids and task_execution_event_ids in the same canonical task_id order, an exact bounded task_id -> {task_revision,execution_revision} resulting revision map, resulting Objective aggregate fingerprint/revision, and all Task execution-event result refs; commit atomically

return ObjectiveMutationResultV1 with outcome=APPLIED, objective_id, revision equal to the unchanged current Objective identity revision, and result_refs containing every created task_execution_event in canonical task_id order; exact replay returns this immutable original result before Objective/Task state reads
rules: this command starts Tasks, not the Objective
unselected Tasks remain unchanged
Objective has no independent start event/timestamp/execution authority and objectives.revision is not incremented by this command

ObjectiveMutationResultV1.revision therefore reports the unchanged Objective identity revision used and revalidated by the command; the independently rebuilt objective_aggregate_projection revision is audit authority, not a substitute Objective identity revision
selected_tasks order is nonsemantic; canonical sorting makes differently ordered but otherwise identical requests hash identically, while duplicate task_id rejects rather than silently deduplicates
the batch bound is 100 selected Tasks per command; larger selections require multiple explicit commands rather than an unbounded transaction
Objective becomes derived in_progress only because at least one member has accepted Task start evidence
execution_revision=0 binds exact absence only; a Task with corrected-to-not_started history has a positive execution revision
canonical-now is replay-stable semantic input and is never re-resolved on exact command replay

commands.name: EndTaskExecution
steps: pure-preflight require canonical task_id UUIDv4 text, positive integer task_revision/execution_revision and known UTC whole-second effective_end_utc

inside one writer UoW load exact Task plus positive execution projection and reconcile it to owned history; missing Task returns TASK_NOT_FOUND, Task or execution revision mismatch returns TASK_STALE, missing/current-effective start returns TASK_EXECUTION_NOT_STARTED, and current terminal execution returns TASK_EXECUTION_ALREADY_TERMINAL
require effective_end_utc>=current accepted actual_start_utc
insert one receipt and append exactly one end execution event

rebuild execution projection from complete current history and advance execution revision exactly once; increment tasks.revision exactly once; with no current accepted outcome derive Awaiting Review without fabricating an outcome row
rebuild any affected Objective aggregate/Needs Attention projection in the same UoW while preserving Task plan/source and Objective envelope authority
audit one task.execution_changed.v1 event with exact end-event ref plus resulting Task/execution revisions and commit atomically
rules: ending execution never fabricates Completed/Incomplete outcome
execution_revision must be positive because accepted start authority already exists
material end advances both umbrella Task revision and execution projection revision exactly once

commands.name: CorrectTaskExecutionEvidence
steps: inside UoW prove target is current-effective evidence and correction produces a valid chronology
insert receipt and append correction event targeting exact prior evidence
rebuild execution/outcome validity and affected Objective aggregate; invalidate current Objective review fingerprint when material
audit correction refs and commit
rules: prior event remains immutable
cannot use correction to manufacture cancelled_without_execution while an uncorrected accepted start remains

commands.name: CancelTaskWithoutExecution
steps: inside UoW prove no accepted start and no terminal execution/outcome
insert receipt
append manual_cancel execution event and reviewed outcome event=cancelled_without_execution using recording time as reviewed_at
update projections
rebuild affected Objective aggregate and commit audit
rules: effective cancellation and reviewed/recording time are distinct
provider WFM status is unchanged

commands.name: ReviewTaskOutcome
steps: inside UoW revalidate exact execution evidence
completed/incomplete require accepted started work with terminal end/termination; cancelled_without_execution requires no accepted start and terminal cancellation/termination evidence
insert receipt and append outcome review event
set current outcome/reviewed_at
rebuild Objective aggregate/current-review validity
audit and commit
commands.rule: reviewed_at is acceptance time and never substitutes for actual start/end/termination

commands.name: CorrectTaskOutcome
steps: inside UoW validate replacement against current corrected execution evidence
insert receipt and append new outcome event correction_of exact prior event
update current outcome
rebuild Objective aggregate and invalidate any Objective review whose fingerprint changed
audit and commit
commands.rule: same Task attempt/history survives; retry is separate command

commands.name: ResolveWfmSourceTerminalConsequence
steps: inside UoW require exact pending wfm_source_terminal_reviews row, current provider Complete or Plan Cancel evidence, matching source projection revision and recomputed local input fingerprint
insert receipt

retain_local_work transitions review only and leaves execution/membership intact; terminate_local_work appends source_terminal_consequence termination evidence but no Task outcome and links the review to that event
update review/projections
if an in-progress Objective loses its last executable Task derive Incomplete — Awaiting Review attention; otherwise surviving work continues with warning
audit and commit
rules: never modifies provider status
provider Complete/Plan Cancel alone does not execute this command
terminal Objective membership is not silently restructured
